## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 .github/scripts/validate_site.py` passes
- [ ] Checked locally with `python3 -m http.server 8000` (not `file://`)
- [ ] If a post was added: `posts.json` entry added, and `sitemap.xml` updated
- [ ] If a translation was added: `translationSlug` set on **both** language entries
- [ ] Shared header/footer regions left untouched, or updated in **all** page files
